values: Zea Voice | Beta 1 core test checklist
P0 = release blocker; P1 = core behavior. Record evidence for every failure. Use staging and authorized test numbers.
Set Status and capture actual result, tester, test time (IST), call/task ID, and issue/evidence link. All cases start Not Started.
Call the assigned inbound number; speak and listen.
Agent answers; both sides hear clearly; correct agent is used.
Trigger outbound tests: answer one; leave one unanswered; reject one.
Correct destination; answered/no-answer/busy or provider-supported result recorded.
Test caller hangup, requested agent hangup, and authorized forced hangup.
Call ends; final status recorded; capacity released; no stuck call.
Download the recording and compare caller/agent speech with the transcript.
Audio is accessible only to authorized accounts; both sides captured; no unexplained omissions.
Ask only the doctor name; correct the agent if it adds unwanted details.
Answers the exact question briefly; correction respected; no repeated unwanted response.
Say yes/okay after agreeing to talk; say Hello during an ongoing conversation.
Interprets reply against last question; does not restart greeting or ask permission repeatedly.
Speak a long sentence with natural pauses; interrupt the agent; remain silent while it speaks.
No premature turn completion; real interruption handled; no false user speech or repeated audio.
Speak natural Tamil/Tanglish; say no further help is needed.
Natural configured language; no name repeated every turn; agent closes without repeated questions.
Ask doctor name, hospital location, and supported services. Compare with approved KB.
Answers agree with approved KB; no invented services, experience or capabilities.
Ask current fee and what it covers; compare with configured live data.
Verified current amount, unit and exclusions; no historical or invented price.
Ask a price or service detail absent from configured sources.
Clearly states uncertainty; does not fabricate facts or promise unsupported actions.
Check source details for factual answers as Developer; compare with retrieved content.
Sources support the answer; unexpected missing/wrong sources logged for investigation.
State your own name; finish call; call again from the same number.
Verified name appears in conversation; returning greeting uses it once; no repeated name question.
Say the stored name is wrong and provide your own corrected name.
Authorized update saves corrected name; later calls use it; no repeated correction loop.
Request an appointment for a relative and provide their patient name.
Patient name retained for request; caller profile is not overwritten with relative name.
Return with known name, phone and location; inspect conversation and Report Contact Name.
Briefly verifies known details; asks only missing fields; report name matches saved contact (log mismatch as defect).
Request appointment; supply missing concern, visit preference, date and time; approve submission.
All required fields retained; configured submission verified; request is not falsely called a confirmed booking.
Answer one intake field; ask service/fee question; then continue appointment request.
Answers interruption and resumes next missing field; never restarts intake.
Provide your own name during intake so update_contact executes; continue with location.
Tool completion retains goal and supplied fields; no premature anything-else closing.
Test missing submission tool or controlled tool failure in staging.
No claim of booking, saving, staff notification or delivery without verified success.
Request callback after 2 minutes while busy. Observe tool result, queue and call.
Exactly one saved task; one closing; hangup after playback; dispatch when due and eligible.
Schedule callback; correct the time; separately test cancellation.
Latest request wins; no duplicate active callback; canceled task never dials.
Request callback; hang up after saved success. Restart worker before due time in staging.
Saved task survives hangup/restart; eligible callback dispatches once; no duplicate dialing.
Do not answer callback; call inbound afterward.
Uses verified history/current purpose; does not claim missed call was answered or task was saved from summary alone.
Upload known test contacts; inspect preview, import payload, tasks and dialed numbers.
Every queued/dialed number matches uploaded data; no old template contacts.
Import invalid numbers and duplicate phone rows; compare import counts with configured policy.
Invalid rows rejected visibly; duplicate policy applied consistently; counts reconcile.
Set company/campaign limit 2; inbound queue 100; outbound queue 1000; upload 100 authorized test leads.
At most 2 shared active calls; eligible remainder waits; slots reused; no loss/duplicates.
Test schedule/timezone/retries; pause/resume/cancel; add inbound traffic; test wait limit.
No out-of-window campaign dialing; canceled tasks stay canceled; shared limit respected; configured waiting/timeout works.
Compare final call status, transcript, recording, summary and verified tool outcomes.
Records match actual call; summary does not establish unsupported booking/callback success.
Use known-duration calls; reconcile configured rates/Plivo rounding; replay callback in staging.
Expected cost and balance; no duplicate debit; distinguish platform charges from provider charges.
Test User/Developer; disable tabs; attempt direct API access; test all tabs off and re-login.
Allowed tabs only; disabled actions denied; User cannot see cost/sources; existing role boundaries preserved.
Use two companies; attempt cross-company IDs; exhaust test credits while tasks wait.
No cross-company records/actions; credit policy enforced; no unauthorized or duplicate calls.
